#Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo1,0.4)
Landlord: Oh, I thought I heard you. Going somewhere? 
Damn…{{wi}} I didn’t make it inside in time….
You: Y-yeah, just…{{wi}} you know…{{wi}} stroll around a little..,
Landlord: Stroll around? It’s freezing cold outside?! Are you mad?!
You: I-it isn’t that bad.
Landlord: Hmmm…
Landlord: Well then, I’m not going to stop you.
